name: Moja muzykal'naja oderzhimost' (ne) podvergaetsja ser'joznym somnenijam
original_name: Моя музыкальная одержимость (не) подвергается серьёзным сомнениям
source: Small sketches from school life. A little daydreaming and thoughtfulness. All this is in one game day, which can be completed in 15 minutes.
